🔥 The fire settles. Maeve has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. David says "The fire feels smaller now." Raquel says "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

tableLines.line: The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. A person, maybe 30s speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Cheyenne speaks at Ashford's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Mateo speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 3 people under Deshawn.
🧳 Stonebridge has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A mother from The Red Table pressed a carved token into your hand: "for the winter you fed us." You didn't know there was a winter you'd fed.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
With Haven grieving, Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 6,000 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
